# CPLX0-7450_RXN (flagella-cascade investigation, 2026-08-06): the flagellar motor
# SWITCH complex (C-ring), a real staged intermediate that was entirely MISSING from
# the model -- FliG/FliM/FliN were previously consumed directly (1 copy each) straight
# into FLAGELLAR-MOTOR-COMPLEX_RXN with no intermediate stage at all. Real
# stoichiometry per cryo-EM structural studies (Salmonella, direct homolog of E. coli):
# FliG=34 (C-ring 34-fold rotational symmetry, used as the reference count for other
# switch-complex measurements), FliM~34 (varies 34-58 depending on CW/CCW rotational
# bias; 34 used as a representative baseline, matching the CCW-biased estimate),
# FliN=111+/-13 (major structural component, "Precise Measurement of the Stoichiometry
# of the Adaptive Bacterial Flagellar Switch," PMC10128058). NOTE: an earlier working
# spreadsheet (Maya's "Master Flagella Info") had FliG=26 instead of 34 -- two
# independent literature searches this session both gave 34 as the C-ring's defining
# symmetry number, so 34 is used here, but this is a real, unresolved discrepancy
# flagged for Maya to double check against her own source for 26 if she has one.
# Original (FliG/FliM/FliN only), kept per standing preserve-old-code rule:
# {"CPLX0-7450": 1, "FLIG-FLAGELLAR-SWITCH-PROTEIN": -34, "FLIM-FLAGELLAR-C-RING-SWITCH": -34, "FLIN-FLAGELLAR-C-RING-SWITCH": -111}
# MS-RING ORDERING FIX (2026-08-11, flagella-cascade investigation): added
# FliF (MS-ring, -34) as a reactant here. Real assembly order (Minamino &
# Namba 2008 Nature; Chevance & Hughes 2008 Nat Rev Microbiol -- the SAME
# citation already used for the C-ring -> export-apparatus hierarchy fix
# this session) is: MS-ring (FliF) forms FIRST, THEN the C-ring
# (FliG/FliM/FliN) assembles onto its cytoplasmic face -- export apparatus
# insertion comes only after that. Before this fix, FliF was consumed
# separately, much later, lumped directly into FLAGELLAR-MOTOR-COMPLEX_RXN
# alongside unrelated stator/rod/ring parts -- the same category of
# ordering gap already found and fixed once for CPLX0-7451, just one stage
# further upstream and left unaddressed until now. CPLX0-7450 now
# represents the merged "MS-ring + C-ring" structure (many structural
# papers do describe these as forming one continuous ring assembly, not
# always as two independently-isolable intermediates, so this is a
# reasonable single-stage merge rather than inventing a third complex ID).
# FLAGELLAR-MOTOR-COMPLEX_RXN's separate direct FliF consumption was
# removed in the same change (see complexation_reactions_modified.tsv) so
# FliF is consumed exactly once, here.
CPLX0-7450_RXN
_comments: MS-ring (FliF x34) + C-ring (FliG/FliM/FliN) merged -- real assembly order has MS-ring form first, C-ring assemble onto it (Minamino & Namba 2008 Nature). Previously FliF was consumed separately at the final motor-complex stage; moved here 2026-08-11.
